previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Controller observation failures stop the input actor without asking the running native frontend to stop
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: Bus overflow/observer error sets bus.stop; action failure sets it; delayed action reaches its caller cutoff.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: The while condition and exception/cutoff branches exit without native_cleanup_exit. Only one useful-deadline branch tries cleanup. A live HermesCLI.run/Application therefore may keep waiting after the sole exit-driving actor has stopped, and NativeProducer finally cannot run until the original frontend returns or the separate future guardian kills it.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Give every actor stop/failure/cutoff branch one bounded fixed owned cleanup dispatch, independently record dispatch failures and late/missing native return, and retain original errors. The future exact guardian remains mandatory; never replace the native return or bypass the original deadline.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static stop/exception funnel defect, separate from the explicitly unbound future guardian.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Every stop/bus overflow/observation/action failure/cutoff takes one bounded cleanup-request funnel; .25s Root-pinned cleanup reserve remains inside original30; primary actor errors and missing native return retained. Fresh exact guardian proof remains mandatory and currently UNBOUND.
